name: AWS Braket: Process Results
description: Calls the quantum algorithm sidecar to post-process raw AWS Braket measurement data into a classical answer (POST /process-results). Part of the AWS Braket Algorithm Accelerator pattern — requires the AWS Braket Connector.

properties.label: Process Results URL
properties.description: Full URL of the sidecar's /process-results endpoint. The default FEEL expression appends the path to the sidecarUrl process variable.

properties.label: Request Body (FEEL)
properties.description: FEEL object sent as the sidecar request body. Must include algorithm, the original problem, and results — the raw Braket measurement data from braketResult.result as set by the AWS Braket Connector's GET_TASK_RESULT result expression. Note: Braket returns measurementProbabilities, not bit counts as in IBM Quantum.

properties.label: Result Variable
properties.description: Process variable to store the raw sidecar HTTP response

properties.label: Result Expression
properties.description: Maps the sidecar response to process variables. For Grover use = {classicalResult: response.body}. For QAOA use = {objectiveValue: response.body.objective_value, currentBestBitstring: response.body.best_bitstring, counts: response.body.counts, costs: response.body.costs}.

properties.label: Error Expression
properties.description: FEEL expression to map sidecar HTTP errors to BPMN errors
